title: Lifting a local clause
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$, and let a clause be a conjunction of literals on $r+a$ coordinates, with no coordinate repeated. Its lift is the clause on $r+K$ coordinates obtained by applying the local-prefix embedding to each literal, preserving the literals’ required signs.
hypotheses_covered: The clause is a DNFTerm on $r+a$ coordinates, so its literal indices are pairwise distinct
